name: Todo (Node)
summary: A todo list in a pane, written in Node.js, kept in the plugin's data folder.
description: The Todo sample in Node.js. A plain todo list. Add with Return, edit in place, check off with Space, reorder by dragging or with ⌥↑ and ⌥↓, delete with the Delete key. Completed todos sit in a collapsible group, or are hidden. The list survives restarts and can be kept per workspace. Needs Node.js, which you install yourself.

groups.title: List
groups.description: How the list is shown and where it is kept.

groups.title: Storage
groups.description: Todos are plain text files, never part of a configuration export.

items.label: Show completed
items.help: Off hides the Completed group. Remembered for each workspace.

banner.text: This plugin needs Node.js. Install it from nodejs.org or with Homebrew (brew install node); a copy managed by nvm, fnm or Volta is not found by Vektor.

items.label: A list for each workspace
items.help: On: every workspace has its own todos. Off: one list for all.

items.label: Storage location
items.help: Leave empty to keep the todos in this plugin's own data folder.
